```{r}
library(tidyverse)
#system("git push origin main --force")

#make sure IRS data is loaded in
irs_data = read_csv(paste0(datapath, "irs_migration_data_2012-2022.csv")) |>
  filter(!is.na(dist),
         sender_FIPS != receiver_FIPS) |> #lm() automatically removes missing data but maybe this speeds it up a tad
  mutate(instate = (sender_state == receiver_state))

cvap = read.csv(paste0(datapath, "final_with_CVAP_after_divide.csv")) |>
  mutate(fips = sprintf("%05d", county_fips)) |>
  select(-county_fips) |>
  rename(cvap_2012 = CVAP_EST_2012,
         cvap_2016 = CVAP_EST_2016,
         cvap_2020 = cvap_est)
cvap <- cvap %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("_"), # Selects columns with CVAP_YYYY or total_YYYY
    names_to = c(".value", "year"),
    names_sep = "_") |>
  rename(turnout = total.CVAP) |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))

#political salience = turnout (for now)
#scaled_salience = turnout * partisan bias

cvap = cvap |>
  mutate(scaled_salience = (gop - dem)/cvap) |>
  select(scaled_salience, fips, year)

cvap = rbind(cvap, 
             cvap |> mutate(year = year +1),
             cvap |> mutate(year = year +2),
             cvap |> mutate(year = year +3)) #kind of a busted way to do this but it works

irs_data = irs_data |>
  left_join(cvap |> rename(receiver_FIPS = fips, receiver_salience = scaled_salience), by = join_by(year, receiver_FIPS))

irs_data = irs_data |>
  left_join(cvap |> rename(sender_FIPS = fips, sender_salience = scaled_salience), by = join_by(year, sender_FIPS))
```

```{r}
model = lm(log(people_flow) ~ log(sender_density)*log(receiver_density) + log(sender_pop) + log(receiver_pop) + instate*poly(log(1+dist),3) + as.factor(uic_receiver)*as.factor(uic_sender) + as.factor(year) + I(sender_salience - receiver_salience) + sender_salience*receiver_salience, data = irs_data)

model = lm(log(people_flow) ~ log(sender_pop) + log(receiver_pop) + poly(log(1+dist),4) + instate, data = irs_data )

summary(model)

irs_data$fitted = exp(predict(model, irs_data))

irs_data <- irs_data |>
  mutate(residual = log(people_flow) - log(fitted))

#all of the lowest residuals are in virginia, likely due to very low dist for cities within counties

#run regression with political salience measure and urban influence codes
#experiment with raw voter turnout 
```
